title: There is no patch yet for the FortiMail bug attackers are already using. CVE-2026-104286 is a 9.8 path traversal in Fortinet's mail gateway:
content_md:
There is no patch yet for the FortiMail bug attackers are already using. CVE-2026-104286 is a 9.8 path traversal in Fortinet's mail gateway:

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/fortinet-warns-of-critical-fortimail-flaw-exploited-in-zero-day-attacks/

CVE-2026-104286.evidence: BleepingComputer reports attackers actively exploit the path traversal in FortiMail before any patch exists; CISA added CVE-2026-104286 to the KEV catalog on 2026-10-01.
